_comment: The direction audit (PLAN-todo-tool.md §5, §8 decision 4): todo never reads the delegation layer's files and never names a roster agent; items name repos, not agents. devtools/audit.py fails on any match in any file of this repo outside `skip`. The roster names below are the ones that are not also repo names; they are a copy, taken 2026-10-04, and a new roster agent needs adding here by hand (TODO.md records that this copy can go stale: the tool may not read the roster to refresh it).
_skip: fixtures are other repos' text; audit.json, test_audit.py and mutants.json hold the terms and the planted violations that prove the audit can fail; .claude/hooks/ and .claude/lib/ hold the shared copies setup's hooks component installs, the renderer's files and not this repo's code, gated by `hooks copies` (td-16, Jacob 2026-10-05); .progress/ is the parts runner's progress file and per-part logs (gitignored, never committed), which quote other tools' output verbatim (2026-10-15: checks.log quoted hooks-installed's paths and turned the audit red); the store files at the root (todo.json, todo-history.json, todo-records.json, todo-writes.jsonl and their render TODO.md) are data the todo CLI writes, where a location is named by its one name (PLAN-architecture.md §13.1) even when that name is also an agent's: the audit reads code and docs, never a store as the repo speaking (external audit ra-27.1, Jacob 2026-11-02: store files are data; tools/checks' no-roster exempts the same files)

patterns.why: the interim-rules register (a later harness job reads todo, not the reverse)
the owner resolver: the mapping from repo+work to an agent stays outside todo

_accepted: single lines that hit a term and cannot be changed (an append-only history entry): file and exact stripped text; audit.py fails an entry that matches no line, or a line that hits no term
